			889 = { wif_peace_carvable = yes }
		}
		889 = { transfer_state_to = RKZ }
		889 = { clr_state_flag = wif_peace_allied_state }
	}
	# Costermansville - Zentralafrika
	if = {
		limit = {
			890 = { wif_peace_carvable = yes }
		}
		890 = { transfer_state_to = RKZ }
		890 = { clr_state_flag = wif_peace_allied_state }

	# Burundi

	# Holland
	if = {

		else = {
			7 = { transfer_state_to = GER }
		}

	# Brabant
	if = {

	# The Dutch East Indies: Japan's if Japan is at war in Asia or with the
	# Dutch, otherwise Indonesia goes free (wif_peace_free_the_subjects).
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			wif_peace_carvable = yes
			OWNER = {
				OR = {
					original_tag = INS
					AND = {
						original_tag = HOL
						PREV = { is_on_continent = asia }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {

				has_global_flag = wif_peace_japan_at_war_in_asia
				country_exists = JAP
			}
			transfer_state_to = JAP
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OWNER = { original_tag = HOL } }
			transfer_state_to = INS
		}
		clr_state_flag = wif_peace_allied_state
	}

	# Suriname and Curacao stay Dutch - the government in exile's last
	# territory, under American supervision.
	309 = { clr_state_flag = wif_peace_allied_state }
	695 = { clr_state_flag = wif_peace_allied_state }

	### Scandinavia and Iceland
	# Nordland: Germany takes it whether Norway still holds it or the
	# Reichskommissariat already does.
	144 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {

					is_owned_by = RKG
				}
			}

			clr_state_flag = wif_peace_allied_state

	# Southern Jutland: from an Allied Denmark, or from the Danish
	# protectorate.
	912 = {

				OR = {

						DEN = { is_subject_of = GER }
					}

			clr_state_flag = wif_peace_allied_state

	# Iceland - the Danish protectorate, or Germany

			transfer_state_to = RKG
		}
		else = {
			transfer_state_to = GER
		}
		clr_state_flag = wif_peace_allied_state
	}

	### Poland: the Generalgouvernement's districts to GEN, Ostland's and
	### Ukraine's to those RKs, the rest to Germany. A missing puppet's share
	### goes to Germany.
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			wif_peace_carvable = yes
			OWNER = { original_tag = POL }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					GER_is_GEN_state = yes
					GER_is_east_GEN_state = yes
				}
				country_exists = GEN
			}
			transfer_state_to = GEN
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				GER_is_RKO_state = yes
				country_exists = RKO
			}
			transfer_state_to = RKO
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				GER_is_RKU_state = yes
				country_exists = RKU
			}
			transfer_state_to = RKU
		}
		else = {
			transfer_state_to = GER
		}
		clr_state_flag = wif_peace_allied_state
	}

	### Yugoslavia

			102 = { wif_peace_carvable = yes }

		102 = { clr_state_flag = wif_peace_allied_state }
	}
	# Ljubljana

			853 = { transfer_state_to = ITA }

			103 = { transfer_state_to = ITA }

	}

	if = {

	}
	# Bosnia - Croatia

	### Greece: Bulgaria takes Thrace, the rest becomes a protectorate
	# Thrace
	if = {
		limit = {

	### Everything else the map gives to Germany: what is left of
	### Czechoslovakia, the Baltic states and Albania. An RK takes its own zone
	### if it exists.
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			wif_peace_carvable = yes
			is_on_continent = europe
			OWNER = {
				OR = {
					original_tag = CZE
					original_tag = LUX
					original_tag = BEL
					original_tag = HOL
					original_tag = LIT
					original_tag = LAT
					original_tag = EST
					original_tag = ALB
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				GER_is_RKO_state = yes
				country_exists = RKO
			}
			transfer_state_to = RKO
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				GER_is_RKN_state = yes
				country_exists = RKN
			}
			transfer_state_to = RKN
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				GER_is_RKB_state = yes
				country_exists = RKB
			}
			transfer_state_to = RKB
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				GER_is_RKH_state = yes
				country_exists = RKH
			}
			transfer_state_to = RKH
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OWNER = { original_tag = ALB }
				wif_peace_italy_in_war = yes
				country_exists = ITA
			}
			transfer_state_to = ITA
		}
		else = {
			transfer_state_to = GER
		}
		clr_state_flag = wif_peace_allied_state
	}
}

# Hand Canada the share of the Royal Navy and the RAF that the measurement in
# wif_peace_measure_british_bases put outside the home theatre. The engine has
# no way to ask where a ship or an air wing is, so the share of Britain's naval
# bases and air bases that lie outside Europe, Africa, the Mediterranean and
# the Atlantic stands in for it. transfer_units_fraction only takes fixed
# numbers, hence the tenths. ENG scope.
wif_peace_hand_over_british_fleet = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_peace_navy_share > 0.95 } }
		transfer_units_fraction = {
			target = CAN
			army_ratio = 0
			navy_ratio = 1.0
			air_ratio = 0
			stockpile_ratio = 0
			keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_peace_navy_share > 0.85 } }
		transfer_units_fraction = {
			target = CAN
			army_ratio = 0
			navy_ratio = 0.9
			air_ratio = 0
			stockpile_ratio = 0
			keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_peace_navy_share > 0.75 } }
		transfer_units_fraction = {
			target = CAN
			army_ratio = 0
			navy_ratio = 0.8
			air_ratio = 0
			stockpile_ratio = 0
			keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_peace_navy_share > 0.65 } }
		transfer_units_fraction = {
			target = CAN
			army_ratio = 0
			navy_ratio = 0.7
			air_ratio = 0
			stockpile_ratio = 0
			keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_peace_navy_share > 0.55 } }
		transfer_units_fraction = {
			target = CAN
			army_ratio = 0
			navy_ratio = 0.6
			air_ratio = 0
			stockpile_ratio = 0
			keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_peace_navy_share > 0.45 } }
		transfer_units_fraction = {
			target = CAN
			army_ratio = 0
			navy_ratio = 0.5
			air_ratio = 0
			stockpile_ratio = 0
			keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_peace_navy_share > 0.35 } }
		transfer_units_fraction = {
			target = CAN
			army_ratio = 0
			navy_ratio = 0.4
			air_ratio = 0
			stockpile_ratio = 0
			keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_peace_navy_share > 0.25 } }
		transfer_units_fraction = {
			target = CAN
			army_ratio = 0
			navy_ratio = 0.3
			air_ratio = 0
			stockpile_ratio = 0
			keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_peace_navy_share > 0.15 } }
		transfer_units_fraction = {
			target = CAN
			army_ratio = 0
			navy_ratio = 0.2
			air_ratio = 0
			stockpile_ratio = 0
			keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_peace_navy_share > 0.05 } }
		transfer_units_fraction = {
			target = CAN
			army_ratio = 0
			navy_ratio = 0.1
			air_ratio = 0
			stockpile_ratio = 0
			keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_peace_air_share > 0.95 } }
		transfer_units_fraction = {
			target = CAN
			army_ratio = 0
			air_ratio = 1.0
			navy_ratio = 0
			stockpile_ratio = 0
			keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_peace_air_share > 0.85 } }
		transfer_units_fraction = {
			target = CAN
			army_ratio = 0
			air_ratio = 0.9
			navy_ratio = 0
			stockpile_ratio = 0
			keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_peace_air_share > 0.75 } }
		transfer_units_fraction = {
			target = CAN
			army_ratio = 0
			air_ratio = 0.8
			navy_ratio = 0
			stockpile_ratio = 0
			keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_peace_air_share > 0.65 } }
		transfer_units_fraction = {
			target = CAN
			army_ratio = 0
			air_ratio = 0.7
			navy_ratio = 0
			stockpile_ratio = 0
			keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_peace_air_share > 0.55 } }
		transfer_units_fraction = {
			target = CAN
			army_ratio = 0
			air_ratio = 0.6
			navy_ratio = 0
			stockpile_ratio = 0
			keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_peace_air_share > 0.45 } }
		transfer_units_fraction = {
			target = CAN
			army_ratio = 0
			air_ratio = 0.5
			navy_ratio = 0
			stockpile_ratio = 0
			keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_peace_air_share > 0.35 } }
		transfer_units_fraction = {
			target = CAN
			army_ratio = 0
			air_ratio = 0.4
			navy_ratio = 0
			stockpile_ratio = 0
			keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_peace_air_share > 0.25 } }
		transfer_units_fraction = {
			target = CAN
			army_ratio = 0
			air_ratio = 0.3
			navy_ratio = 0
			stockpile_ratio = 0
			keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_peace_air_share > 0.15 } }
		transfer_units_fraction = {
			target = CAN
			army_ratio = 0
			air_ratio = 0.2
			navy_ratio = 0
			stockpile_ratio = 0
			keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_peace_air_share > 0.05 } }
		transfer_units_fraction = {
			target = CAN
			army_ratio = 0
			air_ratio = 0.1
			navy_ratio = 0
			stockpile_ratio = 0
			keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
		}
	}
}

# The African Reichskommissariats the peace creates. Each springs into being
# when the map hands it its first state; this gives it its Reichskommissar,
# its capital, a garrison and the Reichskommissariat spirit, whose on_add
# (common/ideas/GER.txt) sets the Reichskommissariat economy law. GER scope.
wif_peace_set_up_rkf = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = RKF
			NOT = { RKF = { has_country_flag = wif_peace_rk_set_up } }
		}
		RKF = {
			set_country_flag = wif_peace_rk_set_up
			set_politics = {
				ruling_party = fascism
				elections_allowed = no
			}
			set_popularities = {
				fascism = 80
				democratic = 10
				communism = 5
				neutrality = 5
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_character = RKF_otto_ohlendorf } }
				recruit_character = RKF_otto_ohlendorf
			}
			promote_character = RKF_otto_ohlendorf
			# Capital: Tanganyika (Dar es Salaam)
			if = {
				limit = { owns_state = 546 }
				set_capital = {
					state = 546
					remember_old_capital = no
				}
			}
			inherit_technology = GER
			add_manpower = 30000
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = infantry_equipment
				amount = 4000
				producer = GER
			}
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = support_equipment
				amount = 500
				producer = GER
			}
			every_owned_state = {
				add_compliance = 25
			}
			wif_peace_rk_garrison_template = yes
			capital_scope = {
				create_unit = {
					division = "division_template = \"Sicherungs-Division\" start_experience_factor = 0.3 start_equipment_factor = 1.0"
					owner = RKF
					count = 3
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_dlc = "Death or Dishonor" }
			set_autonomy = {
				target = RKF
				autonomy_state = autonomy_reichskommissariat
			}
		}
		else = {
			puppet = RKF
		}
		RKF = { add_ideas = GER_german_controlled_reichskommissariat }
	}
}

wif_peace_set_up_rkr = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = RKR
			NOT = { RKR = { has_country_flag = wif_peace_rk_set_up } }
		}
		RKR = {
			set_country_flag = wif_peace_rk_set_up
			set_politics = {
				ruling_party = fascism
				elections_allowed = no
			}
			set_popularities = {
				fascism = 80
				democratic = 10
				communism = 5
				neutrality = 5
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_character = RKR_wolf_heinrich_von_helldorff } }
				recruit_character = RKR_wolf_heinrich_von_helldorff
			}
			promote_character = RKR_wolf_heinrich_von_helldorff
			# Capital: Rhodesia (Salisbury)
			if = {
				limit = { owns_state = 545 }
				set_capital = {
					state = 545
					remember_old_capital = no
				}
			}
			inherit_technology = GER
			add_manpower = 30000
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = infantry_equipment
				amount = 4000
				producer = GER
			}
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = support_equipment
				amount = 500
				producer = GER
			}
			every_owned_state = {
				add_compliance = 25
			}
			wif_peace_rk_garrison_template = yes
			capital_scope = {
				create_unit = {
					division = "division_template = \"Sicherungs-Division\" start_experience_factor = 0.3 start_equipment_factor = 1.0"
					owner = RKR
					count = 3
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_dlc = "Death or Dishonor" }
			set_autonomy = {
				target = RKR
				autonomy_state = autonomy_reichskommissariat
			}
		}
		else = {
			puppet = RKR
		}
		RKR = { add_ideas = GER_german_controlled_reichskommissariat }
	}
}

wif_peace_set_up_rkz = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = RKZ
			NOT = { RKZ = { has_country_flag = wif_peace_rk_set_up } }
		}
		RKZ = {
			set_country_flag = wif_peace_rk_set_up
			set_politics = {
				ruling_party = fascism
				elections_allowed = no
			}
			set_popularities = {
				fascism = 80
				democratic = 10
				communism = 5
				neutrality = 5
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_character = RKZ_gulbrand_lunde } }
				recruit_character = RKZ_gulbrand_lunde
			}
			promote_character = RKZ_gulbrand_lunde
			# Capital: Leopoldville
			if = {
				limit = { owns_state = 295 }
				set_capital = {
					state = 295
					remember_old_capital = no
				}
			}
			inherit_technology = GER
			add_manpower = 30000
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = infantry_equipment
				amount = 4000
				producer = GER
			}
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = support_equipment
				amount = 500
				producer = GER
			}
			every_owned_state = {
				add_compliance = 25
			}
			wif_peace_rk_garrison_template = yes
			capital_scope = {
				create_unit = {
					division = "division_template = \"Sicherungs-Division\" start_experience_factor = 0.3 start_equipment_factor = 1.0"
					owner = RKZ
					count = 3
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_dlc = "Death or Dishonor" }
			set_autonomy = {
				target = RKZ
				autonomy_state = autonomy_reichskommissariat
			}
		}
		else = {
			puppet = RKZ
		}
		RKZ = { add_ideas = GER_german_controlled_reichskommissariat }
	}
}
